# Suppliers

Where to buy each part, EU and US. Links go to the vendor's own site rather
than to a marketplace listing, because listings move and vendors do not.

Nothing here is an endorsement or an affiliate link. Prices and availability
change; check before you order.

| Vendor | Region | Sells |
|---|---|---|
| [RFDesign](https://store.rfdesign.com.au) | Worldwide | RFD868x (EU) and RFD900x (US) telemetry |
| [Teltonika Networks](https://teltonika-networks.com) | Worldwide | RUTX routers, dual SIM failover |
| [Dragino](https://www.dragino.com) | Worldwide | LoRaWAN sensors and gateways |
| [The Things Network](https://www.thethingsnetwork.org) | Worldwide | LoRaWAN gateways and community network |

Check the band before ordering. 900 MHz telemetry and 915 MHz RC links are US
allocations and are not legal in the EU. See
[Airframes](/build/airframes#the-frequency-mistake-which-is-easy-and-expensive).

## Free data sources

Not suppliers, but they replace paid subscriptions and belong on this page.

| Source | Provides | Cost |
|---|---|---|
| [Copernicus Data Space](https://dataspace.copernicus.eu) | Sentinel-2 imagery, full archive | Free |
| [DWD Open Data](https://opendata.dwd.de) | German weather observations, radar, ICON model output | Free |
| [Open-Meteo](https://open-meteo.com) | Forecast API, generous free tier | Free to low |
| State geoportals, e.g. [Bavaria](https://geodaten.bayern.de/opengeodata/) | DEM, orthophotos, parcel data as open data | Free |
| [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org) | Base mapping | Free, ODbL attribution |

The satellite and weather sources are not a nice extra. They are what decides
which fields are worth flying, which is the largest single lever on cost per
hectare. See
[disease detection](/features/plant-disease-detection#cost-efficiency).
